name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Styled Solid combobox backed by Keystone input, listbox, selection, and floating behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through ui-combobox classes while Core owns input/listbox roles, selection, form value, and positioning.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers the core input, popup/listbox, item highlighting, selection, form value, and floating positioning contract through Keystone. Gaps: Base UI depth around field integration, collection virtualization, grouped items, scroll arrows, modal backdrop behavior, clear button semantics, and async filtering remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Follows Kobalte Solid composition by building from form-control, listbox, selection, and popper-style pieces. Gaps: hidden select parity, multiple selection, section/group APIs, robust typeahead, controlled inputValue/open coordination, and reset semantics remain follow-up work.
